'''Nathan Russell''' (GEMP handle '''bibfortuna''') is a member of the [[Killer Bees]]. He finished third at the [[2024 Eighth Annual GEMPC]] (seed 100); the Players Committee wrap prints the handle next to his name.<ref name="pc-gempc8">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-second-career-gemp-match-play-championship/ Matthew Harrison-Trainor Wins Second Career GEMP Match Play Championship], Players Committee (30 May 2024)</ref> He finished '''#29''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 30).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
